name: Paw of Sin'Dall
summary: The Paw of Sin'Dall is proof of a difficult hunt in Stranglethorn Vale. Ajeck Rouack asks you to bring it to Nesingwary's Expedition.

sections.title: Proof of the Hunt
sections.body: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Ajeck Rouack sets you after Sin'Dall, an elusive tiger tracked for weeks. He asks you to return with her paw as proof of the hunt. Bring it back, and he will hail you as a true Master Tiger Hunter.

faq.answer: Sin'Dall is an elusive tiger in Stranglethorn Vale, hunted by Ajeck Rouack and the trackers at Nesingwary's Expedition.

faq.q: Why does Ajeck want Sin'Dall's paw?
faq.answer: Ajeck Rouack asks you to bring Sin'Dall's paw as proof that you hunted and killed her.

faq.q: Where do I take the Paw of Sin'Dall?
faq.answer: Bring the Paw of Sin'Dall to Ajeck Rouack at Nesingwary's Expedition.
The paw proves to Ajeck Rouack that you completed the hunt for Sin'Dall.

angles.text: As a Hunter, Ajeck Rouack's challenge asks you to track and kill Sin'Dall, then bring back proof of the hunt.
